Biography
Dr. Robert Lightfoot holds a BS in Computer Science and a PhD in Multidisciplinary Engineering (combining computer science and engineering education), both from Texas A&M University. He also earned an MS in Software Engineering from Southern Methodist University. With 28 years of industry experience, Dr. Lightfoot has developed large-scale networks and network-controlled robotics, bringing  real-world expertise to the classroom.
